# Traders Window

> Free live crypto market tools in the browser (Binance funding rates, open interest, long/short ratio, Crypto Fear & Greed Index, altcoin season index, an economic calendar with FOMC/CPI/jobs report dates, crypto market hours), plus a free always-on-top crypto price widget for macOS. No account, no ads, no tracking.

The tools load public data straight from Binance, alternative.me and CoinPaprika in the visitor's browser. A written summary of the market is added to each tool page every day around 06:00 UTC, with the date, so the numbers below can be quoted with that date.

<!--snap-->
## Crypto market on 24 Oct 2026 (16:16 UTC)

- Bitcoin is at $79,849 (−2.2% in 24 hours) and Ethereum at $2,310 (−3.9%).
- The Crypto Fear and Greed Index is 51 (Neutral), compared with 50 yesterday, 55 a week ago, 71 a month ago.
- Bitcoin dominance is 57.5% and the total crypto market is worth $2.78 trillion (−2.6% in 24 hours).
- The altcoin season index is 60: 30 of the top 50 altcoins did better than Bitcoin over the last 90 days, so it's not altcoin season yet (that takes 75).
- BTC funding on Binance is +0.0006% every 8 hours (+0.7% a year), so longs pay shorts. ETH funding is −0.0012%.
- BTC open interest on Binance is $7.59 billion, +0.4% in 24 hours.
- 69.0% of Binance accounts holding a BTC futures position are long (long/short ratio 2.23).
- Next: FOMC rate decision, Wed 28 Oct at 18:00 UTC (in 4 days). After that: US jobs report (NFP) on Fri 6 Nov; US CPI inflation on Tue 10 Nov; US jobs report (NFP) on Fri 4 Dec.
- Technical readings for the next 7 days, from the daily close of 23 Oct 2026: Bitcoin Sideways (higher 7 days later in 46% of 489 similar days, 53% on an ordinary day; likely range −4.9% to +6.1%); Ethereum Sideways (higher 7 days later in 45% of 469 similar days, 51% on an ordinary day; likely range −6.8% to +8.4%). Other coins: Solana sideways, XRP no clear direction, BNB sideways, Dogecoin no clear direction, Cardano no clear direction, TRON leaning up, Avalanche no clear direction, Chainlink leaning down, Sui no clear direction, Toncoin not enough history, Polkadot leaning down, Litecoin no clear direction, Bitcoin Cash no clear direction, NEAR no clear direction, Aptos no clear direction, Uniswap no clear direction, Aave sideways, Pepe no clear direction.

## Free tools

- [Crypto market today](https://traderswindow.github.io/tools/crypto-market-today/): The crypto market today on one page: Bitcoin and Ethereum price, Fear & Greed, Bitcoin dominance, altcoin season, BTC funding, open interest, long/short ratio and the next big event.
- [Crypto technical analysis](https://traderswindow.github.io/tools/crypto-technical-analysis/): Free technical analysis for Bitcoin, Ethereum and 18 more coins: trend, momentum and volatility, what happened next in similar setups since 2017, the likely price range for the next 7 or 30 days, and a public record of every call.
- [Binance funding rates, live](https://traderswindow.github.io/tools/funding-rates/): Live funding rates for every Binance USDT perpetual: current rate, annualized, interval and countdown to the next payment, plus a calculator for what funding costs you.
- [Open interest, live](https://traderswindow.github.io/tools/open-interest/): Live open interest for Binance USDT perpetuals: value in dollars, 1-hour and 24-hour change, the trend over time and what each combination of price and open interest means.
- [Long/short ratio, live](https://traderswindow.github.io/tools/long-short-ratio/): Live long/short ratio from Binance Futures for BTC, ETH and any altcoin: all accounts, top traders and taker buy/sell volume, with the trend over time.
- [Crypto Fear & Greed Index](https://traderswindow.github.io/tools/crypto-fear-and-greed-index/): Today's Crypto Fear and Greed Index with yesterday, last week and last month, a one-year chart against the Bitcoin price, and how Bitcoin did after each reading since 2018.
- [Altcoin season index](https://traderswindow.github.io/tools/altcoin-season-index/): Is it altcoin season? A live index of how many of the top 50 altcoins beat Bitcoin over the last 90 days, plus Bitcoin dominance and the total crypto market cap.
- [Crypto economic calendar](https://traderswindow.github.io/tools/crypto-economic-calendar/): The scheduled events that move Bitcoin: FOMC rate decisions, US CPI inflation, the jobs report and BTC options expiry, with countdowns in your time zone and a calendar you can subscribe to.
- [Crypto market hours](https://traderswindow.github.io/tools/crypto-market-hours/): Crypto trades 24/7, but its volume follows the stock markets. See which sessions are open right now, in your time zone: Tokyo, London, New York and CME Bitcoin futures.
- Technical analysis for each coin, updated daily: [Bitcoin](https://traderswindow.github.io/tools/crypto-technical-analysis/bitcoin/), [Ethereum](https://traderswindow.github.io/tools/crypto-technical-analysis/ethereum/), [Solana](https://traderswindow.github.io/tools/crypto-technical-analysis/solana/), [XRP](https://traderswindow.github.io/tools/crypto-technical-analysis/xrp/), [BNB](https://traderswindow.github.io/tools/crypto-technical-analysis/bnb/), [Dogecoin](https://traderswindow.github.io/tools/crypto-technical-analysis/dogecoin/), [Cardano](https://traderswindow.github.io/tools/crypto-technical-analysis/cardano/), [TRON](https://traderswindow.github.io/tools/crypto-technical-analysis/tron/), [Avalanche](https://traderswindow.github.io/tools/crypto-technical-analysis/avalanche/), [Chainlink](https://traderswindow.github.io/tools/crypto-technical-analysis/chainlink/), [Sui](https://traderswindow.github.io/tools/crypto-technical-analysis/sui/), [Toncoin](https://traderswindow.github.io/tools/crypto-technical-analysis/toncoin/), [Polkadot](https://traderswindow.github.io/tools/crypto-technical-analysis/polkadot/), [Litecoin](https://traderswindow.github.io/tools/crypto-technical-analysis/litecoin/), [Bitcoin Cash](https://traderswindow.github.io/tools/crypto-technical-analysis/bitcoin-cash/), [NEAR](https://traderswindow.github.io/tools/crypto-technical-analysis/near/), [Aptos](https://traderswindow.github.io/tools/crypto-technical-analysis/aptos/), [Uniswap](https://traderswindow.github.io/tools/crypto-technical-analysis/uniswap/), [Aave](https://traderswindow.github.io/tools/crypto-technical-analysis/aave/), [Pepe](https://traderswindow.github.io/tools/crypto-technical-analysis/pepe/)

## Guides

- [What is the funding rate in crypto?](https://traderswindow.github.io/learn/funding-rate/): What the funding rate on crypto perpetual futures is, who pays whom, how to read positive, negative and extreme funding, and what a funding flip means.
- [What is open interest, and how do you read it with price?](https://traderswindow.github.io/learn/open-interest/): Open interest explained: how it differs from volume, the four price and open interest combinations, and what rising or falling OI tells a crypto trader.
- [Crypto liquidations: what they are and how to read them](https://traderswindow.github.io/learn/liquidations/): How crypto futures liquidations work, why they cascade, what long and short liquidation data tells you, and how to watch your own liquidation distance.
- [How to set crypto price alerts on a Mac that you won't miss](https://traderswindow.github.io/learn/crypto-price-alerts-mac/): Ways to get crypto price alerts on macOS, why most of them get missed, and how to set up on-screen alerts in dollars, percent or volatility with Traders Window.
- [TradingView alert limits, and how to get unlimited price alerts](https://traderswindow.github.io/learn/tradingview-alert-limits/): Why TradingView caps your active alerts, what to keep there, and how to get unlimited price, % and volatility alerts on your Mac for free.
- [How to get an alert when the funding rate flips or spikes](https://traderswindow.github.io/learn/funding-rate-alerts/): Get alerted when a crypto perpetual's funding rate flips sign or reaches an extreme, with a countdown to the next payment, on your Mac and phone.
- [Liquidation alerts: catch cascades and protect your own position](https://traderswindow.github.io/learn/liquidation-alerts/): Get alerted when a wave of crypto liquidations hits a coin, and when your own futures position gets close to its liquidation price.
- [How to keep a crypto price on top of full-screen apps on a Mac](https://traderswindow.github.io/learn/crypto-price-over-full-screen-mac/): Why most Mac widgets disappear when a chart goes full screen, and how to keep a live crypto price floating on top of every app, including full-screen ones.
- [Menu bar crypto ticker or floating widget: which one to use](https://traderswindow.github.io/learn/menu-bar-ticker-vs-floating-widget/): An honest comparison of Mac menu bar crypto tickers and floating price widgets: what each is good at, update speed, alerts and full-screen behavior.
- [How to set a daily loss limit for crypto trading, and actually stick to it](https://traderswindow.github.io/learn/daily-loss-limit/): What a daily loss limit is, how to size it, and how to keep it in view with a widget that turns red when you hit it, trade caps and a cooldown after losses.
- [Crypto trading sessions: when Asia, London and New York are open](https://traderswindow.github.io/learn/crypto-trading-sessions/): Crypto trades 24/7, but activity doesn't. The Asia, London and New York session hours in UTC, summer and winter, the overlaps, and the other daily times that matter.
- [The Crypto Fear & Greed Index: what it measures and how to use it](https://traderswindow.github.io/learn/fear-and-greed-index/): What goes into the Crypto Fear & Greed Index, how to read extreme fear and extreme greed, why it works better as context than as a signal, and where to see it.
- [Bitcoin dominance: what it is and how to read it](https://traderswindow.github.io/learn/bitcoin-dominance/): What Bitcoin dominance (BTC.D) measures, how to read it together with the Bitcoin price, why stablecoins distort it, and why different sites show different numbers.
- [Volatility-based price alerts: why one percentage doesn't fit every coin](https://traderswindow.github.io/learn/volatility-alerts/): Why a fixed percentage alert is too noisy for small coins and too quiet for Bitcoin, and how alerts measured in σ, each coin's normal hourly move, fix it.
- [Order flow for crypto traders: taker buying, selling and large trades](https://traderswindow.github.io/learn/order-flow-large-trades/): What taker buy and sell volume shows, how to read a 5-minute order flow bar, and how to spot large trades on Binance futures, with the limits of public trade data.
- [How to create a read-only Binance API key, and keep it safe](https://traderswindow.github.io/learn/binance-read-only-api-key/): Step by step: create a Binance API key that can only read your account, which permissions to leave off, where to store it, and what to do if it leaks.
- [Revenge trading: how to spot it and how to stop](https://traderswindow.github.io/learn/revenge-trading/): What revenge trading is, the warning signs, why it happens after a loss, and practical rules that stop it: cooldowns, trade caps and a daily loss limit you can see.
- [Crypto price apps for Mac compared (2026)](https://traderswindow.github.io/learn/crypto-price-apps-mac/): Coin Tick, TickerPad, CoinBar, Crypto Drop, Bitcoin Ticker Widget and Traders Window compared: where each shows prices, price, data source, alerts and full-screen behavior.

## The Mac app

- [Traders Window for macOS](https://traderswindow.github.io/): free floating widget that stays on top of full-screen apps, with live Binance prices, funding, open interest, liquidations and alerts in $, % or volatility. macOS 13+, Apple silicon and Intel.
- [Install guide](https://traderswindow.github.io/install/): the app isn't signed with a paid Apple certificate, so macOS asks you to allow it once.
- [Phone alerts](https://traderswindow.github.io/phone-alerts/): forward the widget's alerts to your phone with ntfy.

## Optional

- [Embeddable widgets](https://traderswindow.github.io/tools/crypto-fear-and-greed-index/#embed): free Fear & Greed and altcoin season widgets for other websites.
- [Subscribable calendar](https://traderswindow.github.io/calendar/crypto-events.ics): FOMC, CPI, jobs report and BTC options expiry as an .ics feed.
